title: Verdier exchange for Weil complexes
statement:
Let $k_0$ be a finite field, let $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$ be prime, and put $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use the actual derived Weil category $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)$ of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], namely the bounded constructible full subcategory of the derived category of pro-etale Weil module sheaves (live Lean `WeilComplex k₀ ℓ X₀`). Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a separated, quasi-compact, locally finite-type $k_0$-morphism, with $X_0,Y_0$ separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes. Assume that $Ra_{X,0!}$ and $Ra_{Y,0!}$ have right adjoints on these actual derived Weil categories, and define $\omega_X=Ra_{X,0}^!\mathbf 1_0$, $\omega_Y=Ra_{Y,0}^!\mathbf 1_0$ using those adjunctions and the tensor/internal-Hom and dualizing data of [def-sf-derived-weil-category-and-operations]. Let $D_X=R\mathcal Hom_X(-,\omega_X)$ and $D_Y=R\mathcal Hom_Y(-,\omega_Y)$ denote the restricted functors supplied by [lem-sf-weil-verdier-dual-preserves-weil-complexes], interpreted in this actual derived-Weil model as in the displayed live Lean declaration. Then for every $M\in\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)$ there is an isomorphism
$$D_Y(Rf_{0!}M)\cong Rf_*(D_XM)$$
in $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(Y_0)$, for the actual compact-support functor and derived direct image specified in [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], restricted by [lem-sf-native-weil-shriek-triangulated] and [lem-sf-native-weil-pullback-star-preservation].

proof.text: For each T = X,Y and K in WeilComplex(T), construct the Hom equivalence Hom(L,D_T K) = Hom(A_T(K tensor L),1). Use the native closed comparison of lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful, its nativeModel identification with the actual derivedHom, inverse currying, and the symmetry changing K tensor L to L tensor K. Full-subcategory fullness transfers both Hom sets. Follow this with the inverse structural adjunction. Naturality in L is the closed adjunction naturality, braiding naturality, and structural adjunction naturality. The closed comparison is that of def-sf-native-derived-tensor-layer; the tensor K tensor L on the full subcategory is nativeConstructibleTensor of def-sf-native-constructible-tensor.

proof.text: Apply lem-sf-weil-compact-structure-tensor-comparison to f and M. Its Hom equivalence p_L carries Hom(A_Y(FM tensor L),1) to Hom(A_X(M tensor f*L),1), naturally contravariantly in L. Compose the equivalence of step 1 on Y, p_L, the inverse equivalence of step 1 on X, and the ordinary native adjunction f* dashv Rf*. This produces b_L: Hom(L,D_Y(FM)) = Hom(L,Rf*D_X M). Inverting the naturality square of the X equivalence and combining the other three squares proves b_L(g followed by v) = g followed by b_L(v).

proof.text: Let U=D_Y(FM), V=Rf*D_X M, u=b_U(id_U), and v=b_V inverse(id_V). Naturality gives v followed by u = id_V. Applying injectivity of b_U to u followed by v, naturality and b_V(v)=id_V give u followed by v = id_U. These two maps define the required isomorphism U = V in the actual native full subcategory.
